title: Remap a key that stops working when there is a shortcut remap

status.label: Confirm the key-and-shortcut interaction on current stable
status.detail: On PowerToys 0.88.0, single-key remaps reportedly remain active while shortcut remaps stop after a while; the screenshot shows two simple key remaps and one shortcut remap.

judgment.rationale: The author reports that on PowerToys 0.88.0, key remapping and shortcut remapping work for a while but then stop together; leaving only key remapping enabled avoids the failure. The attached screenshot shows two single-key remaps (Page Up to End and Page Down to Play/Pause Media) plus a Ctrl+Right-Bracket-to-vertical-bar shortcut. A related thread (#37215) contains the same reporter's observation that disabling other modules did not help when shortcut remaps remained enabled. These reports support a Keyboard Manager interaction hypothesis, but there is no current-version retest or confirmed fix. Ask for the same minimal configuration on current stable before proposing code changes.
evidence: The issue lists PowerToys 0.88.0 and says remapping a key and a shortcut works for a while, after which both features stop working.
The author says key remapping works without interruption when shortcut remapping is removed.
The screenshot shows Page Up to End, Page Down to Play/Pause Media, and a Ctrl+Right-Bracket-to-vertical-bar shortcut mapping.
The sole issue comment is an automated similar-issue list, not a reporter response or fix.
In #37215, this reporter said that disabling other PowerToys modules did not resolve the failure while shortcut remapping remained enabled.
The issue is open with no assignees.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the simple key-and-shortcut configuration still fails on current stable and whether key remapping continues after the shortcut remap stops.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report and screenshot identify a specific old-build configuration, but no current-version result establishes that the shortcut interaction remains defective.

issue_context.summary: Two single-key remaps and a shortcut remap reportedly stop working together after a while on PowerToys 0.88.0; key remapping alone reportedly remains stable.
known_information: The author says both key and shortcut remapping stop after some time, but key remapping alone remains stable.
The attached screenshot shows Page Up to End, Page Down to Play/Pause Media, and Ctrl+Right-Bracket to a vertical bar.
The same reporter said in #37215 that disabling other PowerToys modules did not resolve the issue while shortcut mappings remained enabled.

inferences: The failure may involve interaction between single-key and shortcut remapping state, but the current build and triggering sequence are unknown.
issue_context.analysis: The screenshot and prior reporter follow-up make this more specific than the automated similarity list, but they do not prove a current code defect. Preserve the simple configuration as the test case and request a current-version result before designing a fix.
initial_investigation: Read the current issue body and comment, including its automated similar-issue list.
Inspected the attached screenshot and verified it shows two key remaps and one shortcut remap.
Read #37215's comments, including this reporter's statement that the issue remained with only Keyboard Manager enabled when shortcut remapping was used.

information_gaps.information: Whether the two single-key remaps and Ctrl+Right-Bracket-to-vertical-bar shortcut still fail together on current stable, and whether the key remaps continue working after the shortcut stops
information_gaps.why_needed: The issue lists PowerToys 0.88.0; a current result confirms whether the reported interaction still exists and isolates which remap path stops.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Recreate the three mappings shown in the screenshot on current stable, use them until the failure occurs, then report whether the Page Up/Page Down remaps and the shortcut still work.

actions.label: Confirm the remap interaction on current stable

comment.body: Thanks for the minimal configuration screenshot and for confirming in #37215 that disabling other modules did not help while shortcut remaps were enabled. Since this report lists PowerToys 0.88.0, could you confirm whether the Page Up/Page Down remaps and Ctrl+Right-Bracket-to-vertical-bar shortcut still stop working together on current stable?
